sections.instruction: Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d:

items.question: Small fish eat ................ in the Nile River.
items.explanation_ar: السمك الصغير بياكل water weeds يعني أعشاب الميه في النيل.
items.explanation_en: In the Nile lesson, small fish eat water weeds.

items.question: ................ is called the king of the Nile.
items.explanation_ar: التمساح بيتسمّى ملك النيل: Crocodile.
items.explanation_en: The crocodile is called the king of the Nile.

items.question: The small fish in the Nile River are ................
items.grading_reason: السياق لا يحدد إجابة واحدة مؤكدة. يُراجع مع المدرس ولا يدخل في الدرجة.
items.explanation_ar: مفيش إجابة واحدة مؤكدة للسؤال ده، فراجعه مع المدرس.
items.explanation_en: This item has no single confirmed answer, so check it with your teacher.

items.question: Birds eat small fish, ................ and even plants near the river.
items.explanation_ar: الطيور بتاكل سمك صغير وinsects يعني حشرات ونباتات جنب النهر.
items.explanation_en: Birds eat small fish, insects and even plants near the river.

items.question: Which of these animals is NOT living in or near the Nile River in Lesson 1?
items.explanation_ar: الدرس بيتكلم عن التماسيح والطيور والسمك الصغير، لكن مفيهوش hippos يعني أفراس النهر.
items.explanation_en: The lesson mentions crocodiles, birds and small fish, but not hippos.

items.question: Tom made crowns from ................ when he was young.
items.explanation_ar: في القصة Tom كان بيعمل تيجان من tree leaves يعني ورق الشجر.
items.explanation_en: In the story Tom made crowns from tree leaves when he was young.

items.question: Tom rested on hot days ................
options: in the shade of the tree
items.answer: in the shade of the tree
items.explanation_ar: Tom كان بيرتاح في الضل بتاع الشجرة في الأيام الحر: in the shade of the tree.
items.explanation_en: On hot days Tom rested in the shade of the tree.

items.question: "Selfish" means ................
items.explanation_ar: selfish معناها أناني، يعني بيهتم بنفسه بس: Caring for oneself only.
items.explanation_en: Selfish means caring only about yourself.

items.question: In the word "branches," what is the consonant cluster?
items.explanation_ar: في كلمة branches الحرفين الأولانيين br- متجمعين كـ consonant cluster يعني تجمّع حروف ساكنة.
items.explanation_en: In branches the consonant cluster is br-, two consonants at the start that blend together.

items.question: Which word has the consonant cluster 'cr-'?
items.explanation_ar: الكلمة اللي بتبدأ بـ cr هي Crops.
items.explanation_en: Crops begins with the cluster cr-.

items.question: ................ helps make our bodies strong.
items.explanation_ar: Swimming رياضة بتقوّي الجسم.
items.explanation_en: Swimming is exercise that makes our bodies strong.

items.question: The ................ help us breathe in oxygen.
items.explanation_ar: lungs يعني الرئتين، وهي اللي بتدخّل الأكسجين للجسم.
items.explanation_en: The lungs help us breathe in oxygen.

items.question: Taking time to relax and sleep well is good for your ................
items.explanation_ar: الراحة والنوم الكويس مفيدين للـ mental health يعني الصحة النفسية.
items.explanation_en: Relaxing and sleeping well are good for mental health.

items.question: The ................ beats to send blood around the body.
items.explanation_ar: heart يعني القلب، وبينبض علشان يبعت الدم في الجسم.
items.explanation_en: The heart beats to send blood around the body.

items.question: Deep breathing and playing outside can reduce ................
items.explanation_ar: التنفس العميق واللعب بره بيقللوا stress يعني التوتر.
items.explanation_en: Deep breathing and playing outside reduce stress.

items.question: Nadia will buy ................ fruits for her grandmother.
items.explanation_ar: some بنستخدمها مع الجمع في الجملة المثبتة: some fruits.
items.explanation_en: Some is used with plural nouns in positive sentences: some fruits.

items.question: My father likes to eat ................ banana every day.
items.explanation_ar: banana مفرد وبيبدأ بحرف ساكن، فنستخدم a.
items.explanation_en: Banana is singular and starts with a consonant sound, so we use a.

items.question: Eating ................ egg for breakfast is good for your health.
items.explanation_ar: egg مفرد وبيبدأ بحرف متحرك، فنستخدم an.
items.explanation_en: Egg is singular and starts with a vowel sound, so we use an.

items.question: There aren't ................ milk left in the fridge.
items.explanation_ar: aren't (نفي) مع milk غير معدود، فنستخدم any.
items.explanation_en: The sentence is negative, so we use any with milk.

items.question: Do you have ................ questions?
items.explanation_ar: السؤال بيستخدم any مع questions.
items.explanation_en: In questions we use any with plural nouns: any questions.

items.question: Blood carries ................ and nutrients to every body cell.
items.explanation_ar: الدم بيحمل oxygen يعني أكسجين ومواد غذائية لكل خلية.
items.explanation_en: Blood carries oxygen and nutrients to every body cell.

items.question: ................ are tubes that carry blood through the body.
items.explanation_ar: Blood vessels يعني الأوعية الدموية، وهي أنابيب بتحمل الدم.
items.explanation_en: Blood vessels are tubes that carry blood through the body.

items.question: Blood carries ................ products like carbon dioxide.
items.explanation_ar: الدم بيحمل المخلفات waste زي ثاني أكسيد الكربون.
items.explanation_en: Blood carries waste products like carbon dioxide.

items.question: The heart is a strong ................ that keeps us alive.
items.explanation_ar: القلب muscle يعني عضلة قوية بتخلينا عايشين.
items.explanation_en: The heart is a strong muscle that keeps us alive.

items.question: Take care of your heart by eating ................ food.
items.explanation_ar: علشان نحافظ على القلب ناكل good food يعني أكل صحي.
items.explanation_en: To take care of your heart, eat good food.

items.question: To stay healthy, you should wash your ................ before and after eating.
items.explanation_ar: بنغسل hands يعني إيدينا قبل الأكل وبعده.
items.explanation_en: We wash our hands before and after eating.

items.question: ................ helps you lose weight and makes your bones stronger.
items.explanation_ar: Exercise regularly يعني ممارسة الرياضة بانتظام بتخسّس وبتقوّي العضم.
items.explanation_en: Exercise regularly helps you lose weight and makes your bones stronger.

items.question: Brush your teeth daily with ................ to stay healthy.
items.explanation_ar: بنفرّش سناننا بـ toothbrush يعني فرشاة.
items.explanation_en: We brush our teeth daily with a toothbrush.

items.question: Eating ................ and vegetables give you important vitamins.
items.explanation_ar: fruits and vegetables بيدّوا فيتامينات مهمة.
items.explanation_en: Fruits and vegetables give you important vitamins.

items.question: Children should ................ to stay healthy and active.
items.explanation_ar: الأطفال لازم sleep early يعني ينامو بدري علشان يفضلوا صحة ونشاط.
items.explanation_en: Children should sleep early to stay healthy and active.

items.question: ................ is a severe wind that carries sand and dust through the air, making it hard to breathe.
items.explanation_ar: Sandstorm يعني عاصفة رملية، ريح شديدة بتشيل الرمل والتراب.
items.explanation_en: A sandstorm is a severe wind that carries sand and dust.

items.question: ................ is a large amount of water covering dry land.
items.explanation_ar: Flood يعني فيضان، كمية كبيرة من الميه بتغطي الأرض الناشفة.
items.explanation_en: A flood is a large amount of water covering dry land.

items.question: A long time without rain is called a ................
items.explanation_ar: drought يعني جفاف، فترة طويلة من غير مطر.
items.explanation_en: A drought is a long time without rain.

items.question: A ................ burns through forests and homes.
items.explanation_ar: wildfire يعني حريق غابات بيحرق الغابات والبيوت.
items.explanation_en: A wildfire burns through forests and homes.

items.question: In a thunderstorm, children might be afraid of ................
items.explanation_ar: في العاصفة الرعدية الأطفال بيخافوا من lightning يعني البرق.
items.explanation_en: In a thunderstorm children might be afraid of the lightning.

items.question: Where did the two best friend frogs live at the beginning of the story?
items.explanation_ar: في بداية القصة الضفدعتين عايشين في small pond يعني بركة صغيرة.
items.explanation_en: At the beginning of the story the frogs lived in a small pond.

items.question: What did the frogs enjoy doing in their home?
items.explanation_ar: الضفادع كانت بتستمتع بـ catching flies يعني صيد الدبان.
items.explanation_en: The frogs enjoyed catching flies in their home.

items.question: What happened to the pond during the hot summer?
items.explanation_ar: في الصيف الحر البركة started to dry up يعني بدأت تنشف.
items.explanation_en: During the hot summer the pond started to dry up.

items.question: What does "leaped" mean in the story?
options: To jump high and far in one big movement
items.answer: To jump high and far in one big movement
items.explanation_ar: leaped معناها قفز عالي ولبعيد في حركة واحدة كبيرة.
items.explanation_en: Leaped means jumped high and far in one big movement.

items.question: What is the main message or moral of "The Two Frogs" story?
items.explanation_ar: العبرة من القصة: Always think before you act يعني فكّر قبل ما تتصرف.
items.explanation_en: The moral of the story is to always think before you act.

items.question: The "beginning" in a fiction story is usually about:
items.explanation_ar: بداية القصة بتعرّفنا بالشخصيات والمكان: Introducing characters and setting.
items.explanation_en: The beginning of a story introduces the characters and the setting.

items.question: The "climax" of a story is:
items.explanation_ar: climax يعني ذروة القصة، وهي أكتر جزء مثير.
items.explanation_en: The climax is the most exciting part of the story.

items.question: A "drought" is:
options: A long period of no rain
items.answer: A long period of no rain
items.explanation_ar: drought معناها فترة طويلة من غير مطر.
items.explanation_en: A drought is a long period with no rain.

items.question: The vowel digraph in "leap" is:
items.explanation_ar: في leap الحروف ea مع بعض بتعمل صوت واحد، يعني vowel digraph.
items.explanation_en: In leap the two letters ea together make one vowel sound, a vowel digraph.

items.question: Which of these is NOT a type of extreme weather discussed in Unit 3?
items.explanation_ar: الوحدة بتتكلم عن الجفاف وحرائق الغابات وموجة الحر، لكن مش blizzard يعني العاصفة الثلجية.
items.explanation_en: Unit 3 covers drought, wildfire and heatwave, not blizzard.

items.question: You can buy fresh bread and cakes from the ................
items.explanation_ar: بنشتري العيش والكيك الفريش من bakery يعني المخبز.
items.explanation_en: You can buy fresh bread and cakes from the bakery.

items.question: He trains three times a week at the fitness ................
items.explanation_ar: بيتدرب في fitness club يعني نادي لياقة.
items.explanation_en: He trains at the fitness club.

items.question: Our family had dinner together at a nice Italian ................
items.explanation_ar: بنتعشى في Italian restaurant يعني مطعم إيطالي.
items.explanation_en: We had dinner at an Italian restaurant.

items.question: The kids had fun on the water rides at the ................
items.explanation_ar: ألعاب الميه موجودة في theme park يعني مدينة الملاهي.
items.explanation_en: Water rides are at a theme park.

items.question: You can go to the ................ to buy groceries.
items.explanation_ar: بنروح supermarket علشان نشتري البقالة.
items.explanation_en: You go to the supermarket to buy groceries.

items.question: Hany was born ................ April.
items.explanation_ar: مع الشهور بنستخدم in: in April.
items.explanation_en: We use in with months: in April.

items.question: The shop closes ................ midnight.
items.explanation_ar: مع الساعة المحددة بنستخدم at: at midnight.
items.explanation_en: We use at with exact times: at midnight.

items.question: We have a picnic ................ Sundays.
items.explanation_ar: مع الأيام بنستخدم on: on Sundays.
items.explanation_en: We use on with days: on Sundays.

items.question: I learned to swim ................ the summer.
items.explanation_ar: مع الفصول بنستخدم in: in the summer.
items.explanation_en: We use in with seasons: in the summer.

items.question: The bell rings ................ 7:30 a.m.
items.explanation_ar: مع الساعة بنستخدم at: at 7:30.
items.explanation_en: We use at with clock times: at 7:30 a.m.

items.question: The New Administrative Capital will help ................ in Cairo by moving many services outside the city.
items.explanation_ar: العاصمة الإدارية الجديدة هتساعد في reduce crowding يعني تقليل الزحمة في القاهرة.
items.explanation_en: The New Administrative Capital will help reduce crowding in Cairo.

items.question: The city is designed as a ................ place with advanced technology and modern systems.
items.explanation_ar: المدينة مصممة كـ very smart place يعني مدينة ذكية بتكنولوجيا حديثة.
items.explanation_en: The city is designed as a very smart place with advanced technology.

items.question: Many ministries and ................ will be relocated to the New Administrative Capital.
items.explanation_ar: الوزارات والمصالح government offices هتتنقل للعاصمة الجديدة.
items.explanation_en: Ministries and government offices will move to the New Administrative Capital.

items.question: The tallest building in Africa, the ................ will be a landmark in the New Administrative Capital.
items.explanation_ar: أطول مبنى في أفريقيا هو Icon Tower.
items.explanation_en: The tallest building in Africa is the Icon Tower.

items.question: The new city's bridges and skyscrapers are built with strong ................ to ensure safety and durability.
items.explanation_ar: الكباري والأبراج مبنية بـ steel يعني صلب قوي علشان الأمان والتحمل.
items.explanation_en: The bridges and skyscrapers use strong steel for safety and durability.

items.question: Precious mineral resources like gold and copper found ................
items.explanation_ar: المعادن الثمينة زي الدهب والنحاس بتتلاقى under the earth يعني تحت الأرض.
items.explanation_en: Precious minerals like gold and copper are found under the earth.

items.question: ................ is soft, shiny, and easy to shape, often used for coins and jewelry.
items.explanation_ar: Gold يعني الدهب: ناعم ولامع وسهل التشكيل، وبيتستخدم في العملات والمجوهرات.
items.explanation_en: Gold is soft, shiny and easy to shape; it is used for coins and jewelry.

items.question: ................ is even more valuable than gold.
items.explanation_ar: Diamond يعني الألماس أغلى من الدهب.
items.explanation_en: Diamond is even more valuable than gold.

items.question: Copper is a strong metal used for ................
items.explanation_ar: النحاس Copper بيتستخدم في electrical wires يعني أسلاك الكهربا.
items.explanation_en: Copper is used for electrical wires.

items.question: What is iron mainly used to make because of its super strength?
items.explanation_ar: الحديد قوي جدا فبنعمل منه cars and bridges يعني عربيات وكباري.
items.explanation_en: Iron is very strong, so it is used to make cars and bridges.

items.question: Billie Wind was a young Native ................ girl who lived in Florida.
items.explanation_ar: Billie Wind بنت Native American يعني من السكان الأصليين لأمريكا وعايشة في فلوريدا.
items.explanation_en: Billie Wind was a young Native American girl who lived in Florida.

items.question: The tribe's elders were ................ when Billie shared her opinion.
items.explanation_ar: الكبار كانوا disappointed يعني خاب أملهم لما Billie قالت رأيها.
items.explanation_en: The elders were disappointed when Billie shared her opinion.

items.question: Billie's family believed that the ................ could "talk"
items.explanation_ar: عيلة Billie كانت بتؤمن إن earth يعني الأرض ممكن تتكلم.
items.explanation_en: Billie's family believed that the earth could talk.

items.question: The elders sent Billie to ................
items.explanation_ar: الكبار بعتوا Billie لـ Everglades.
items.explanation_en: The elders sent Billie to the Everglades.

items.question: The thick part of a tree is called the ................
items.explanation_ar: الجزء السميك من الشجرة اسمه trunk يعني الجذع.
items.explanation_en: The thick part of a tree is called the trunk.

items.question: A ................ person only thinks about himself.
items.explanation_ar: selfish يعني أناني، اللي بيفكر في نفسه بس.
items.explanation_en: A selfish person only thinks about himself.

items.question: We use our ................ to lift heavy things.
items.explanation_ar: بنستخدم muscles يعني عضلاتنا علشان نرفع حاجات تقيلة.
items.explanation_en: We use our muscles to lift heavy things.

items.question: Sleeping well and relaxing is good for your ................
items.explanation_ar: النوم الكويس والراحة مفيدين للـ mental health.
items.explanation_en: Sleeping well and relaxing is good for your mental health.

items.question: The frog ................ over the rock.
items.explanation_ar: الضفدعة leaped يعني قفزت فوق الحجر.
items.explanation_en: The frog leaped over the rock.

items.question: We enjoyed dinner at the Italian ................
items.explanation_ar: بنتعشى في restaurant يعني مطعم إيطالي.
items.explanation_en: We enjoyed dinner at the Italian restaurant.

items.question: ................ are natural substances found in the earth.
items.explanation_ar: Minerals يعني معادن، مواد طبيعية موجودة في الأرض.
items.explanation_en: Minerals are natural substances found in the earth.

items.question: ................ provides energy for plants to grow.
items.explanation_ar: Sunlight يعني ضوء الشمس، بيدّي النباتات طاقة تكبر.
items.explanation_en: Sunlight provides energy for plants to grow.

items.question: ................ are used to produce electricity.
items.explanation_ar: Fossil Fuel يعني الوقود الأحفوري بيتستخدم لإنتاج الكهربا.
items.explanation_en: Fossil fuel is used to produce electricity.

items.question: ................ orbits the Sun once every year.
items.explanation_ar: Earth يعني الأرض بتدور حوالين الشمس مرة كل سنة.
items.explanation_en: The Earth orbits the Sun once every year.

items.question: My new phone is ................ than my old one.
items.explanation_ar: expensive صفة طويلة، فمقارنتها more expensive + than.
items.explanation_en: Expensive is a long adjective, so the comparative is more expensive, followed by than.

items.question: ................ are people who give medicine to patients and explain how to use safely.
items.explanation_ar: Pharmacists يعني الصيادلة، وهم اللي بيدّوا الدوا للمرضى وبيشرحوا استخدامه.
items.explanation_en: Pharmacists give medicine to patients and explain how to use it safely.

items.question: We will meet ................ 5 o'clock.
items.explanation_ar: مع الساعة المحددة بنستخدم at: at 5 o'clock.
items.explanation_en: We use at with clock times: at 5 o'clock.

items.question: The big ship trying to load ................ when it got stuck.
items.explanation_ar: السفينة الكبيرة كانت بتحمّل cargo يعني بضاعة لما اتعلقت.
items.explanation_en: The big ship was loading cargo when it got stuck.

items.question: During a ................, there is no rain for a long time, and the land becomes very dry.
items.explanation_ar: drought يعني جفاف، فترة من غير مطر والأرض بتنشف.
items.explanation_en: A drought is a long time with no rain when the land becomes very dry.

items.question: being healthy and strong through exercise means to be ................
items.explanation_ar: fit يعني لياقة، أن تبقى صحتك وقوتك كويسة بالتمرين.
items.explanation_en: Fit means healthy and strong through exercise.

items.question: She ................ eats breakfast. She has it every morning.
items.explanation_ar: every morning يعني كل يوم، فالظرف المناسب always.
items.explanation_en: She has it every morning, so the adverb is always.

items.question: We have a test ................ Monday.
items.explanation_ar: مع الأيام بنستخدم on: on Monday.
items.explanation_en: We use on with days: on Monday.

items.explanation_en: Read the whole text first. Each word from the box fits the meaning and grammar of its gap. Answers: 1) canals | 2) floodwater | 3) irrigation | 4) sandstorm | 5) bricks
